[spoiler=Stability

(1662 Words)]Stabilization of Enkia

When Enkian troops entered southern Nestorstaat the Kaiserreich was paralyzed by inaction and foreign pressure. Much of the Reichswehr at the time was focused on the fighting in Eastern Shamat as well as southern Elseyr against the combined THEP coalition, leaving much of southern Nestorstaat unguarded. The unforeseen Enkian invasion of southern Nestorstaat was left unconfronted for several weeks as the Kaiserreich became increasingly embroiled in foreign war. The limited ground force in southern Nestorstaat numbering around 1,500 were taken by surprise as Enkian forces crossed the border and took the south. With the majority of Kaiserreich assets sitting in the north and being redeployed to Hydronian Lumir, an immediate military response was not possible. All the limited Reichswehr numbers could do was destroy any remaining equipment in the south to prevent them from being taken by the Enkians and withdrawal under the cover of darkness. 

The surprise palace coup further delayed military action against the Enkians. Throughout the coup and the stabilization period for the new government, an invasion would not have been possible nor feasible. However, as the men returned from Hydronia and the new Hochdeutsche Self Defense Forces (HSDF) were formed, a plan for a return of Nestorstaat to Republik hands began to be conceived. Politically the return of the south to the Hochdeutsche remained a popular sentiment. The Hochdeutsche people had fought over Nestorstaat and spilled blood over it to keep out foreign invaders. Why would they let new ones in without any resistance? In particular, the Patriots Front remained a strong proponent of an invasion of Enkia. The nationalist party, formed largely by supporters of the former monarchy, became an exceptionally vocal minority within the new interim government. Using connections with media oligarchs they would broadcast their message for military action across the airwaves: 

The Republik must continue the great work of defending Elseyr. 

The Hochdeutsche people did not shrink away from the Sikirskian threat, but rather confronted it head-on. 

The same must be done to the Enkian satanist invaders who have trampled upon rightful Gendarmite and Hochdeutsche Christian lands.

These invaders have no place in our lands and must be dealt with quickly and with decisive force. 

Allowing this travesty to continue invites further pillaging of Elseyr, its wealth and its power.

I urge the members of the Republikenrat to vote in favor of immediate military action against Enkia.

- Minority Leader Elisa Hoffman (PvF) in an address to lawmakers in the Republikenrat, 

Extensive lobbying would be conducted inside of the government itself. While an anti-satanist and defense of Elseyr was pushed to the public, the PvF would pressure members of the National Conservatives and Social Democrats to back an invasion plan. Key among the points was that it would satisfy many dissatisfied generals in the Central Military Commission and thus ward off potential coups to restore the Kaiserreich. However, there was also significant contention and resistance to the plan. The left-leaning wing of the Social Democrats, the National Reform Party and the ABS all went into an uproar over proposal over intervention. This, they stated, would be a deviation from the armed neutrality that they believed guided the Republik. 

Eventually a vote would be held on September 2nd on the issue. Last minute backing from the National Conservative PM Sebastian Vogt would put even more pressure on the Republikenrat to deliver a result. In the lower house voting would be fraught with tension with last minute changes and revisions occurring by the hour. Eventually the house would decide to affirm the resolution to invade Enkia, as according to Hoffman this would not violate the armed neutrality doctrine as Enkia had already attacked the Republik through its occupation of the south of Nestorstaat. 172 out of 301 SPD members, 303 out of 305 NKA members, 2 out of 211 NRP, 43 out of 102 ABS, 45 out of 65 GZ members and 104 out of 104 PvF members would vote in favor. A significant coalition between the centrist NKA and SPD with the far-right PvF would eventually win the day on supporting an intervention in Enkia. Eventually, the upper house would approve the second vote three hours after the end decision for the lower house was completed. Republikenrat Security Act 1106 would be signed into law soon after by PM Vogt. 

Following the approval of the act protests and counter-protests would break out across the country. A protest outside the capitol building in Neuedresden quickly attracted pro-PvF counterprotestors who sought to confront supposed satanists that they believed to be in control of the NRP. Eventually the crowd would be dispersed by police before riots could break out, but the mood in Neudresden would be tense. However, the overall mood in the country was in support of the war effort. A surging economy after the release of sanctions and rallying around the flag allowed the NKA and PvF to surge massively in popularity overnight especially in the south. Online, bots continued to spread content that Catholic and Protestant groups were being oppressed by satanists to drive up public support for the war effort. While such tactics are officially denied by the government it is undeniable that it contributed significantly to overall public support for the invasion. 

Following the signing of the legislation the prime minister would deliver a speech before the nation to address the current situation; 

My fellow citizens. 

At this hour Defense Forces have begun operations against Enkian occupiers in southern Nestorstaat. An invasion of the territory by Enkian forces is completely unacceptable. Such actions pose a direct threat to the national security of this Republic and must be dealt with immediately. This occupation is working to oppress the self-determination and rights of the Hochdeutsche people under unjust and unfair Enkian control. 

You have my promise that this war will be fight justly and decisively to force the complete capitulation of Enkian forces.

God bless the Republic and those who defend her.

Invasion of Southern Nestorstaat Under Enkian Occupation

The extensive military buildup created post-THEP intervention and after the Sikirskian war as well as extensive military infrastructure would aid the logistics of the war. Roads and railroads defended by the HAF would ship thousands of troops into forward bases to prepare for war. Supplies including fuel bladders, food, ammunition, and amenities would be brought in to fuel the war effort. Especially critical supplies would be airlifted in from air bases in the northern metropolitan Republik. This constant airlift and sealift as well as utilization of pre placed stores would help the war be executed effectively. 4,500 HDF members, primarily those already stationed in Nestorstaat, would be used in Operation Decisive Storm. However, this war would also see the extensive use of PMCs, something virtually unseen in previous wars. Around 1,900 additional men would be provided by PMCs who would help the war effort from every stage from the logistic to the tactical level. On September 6th, the invasion force 6,400 strong had amassed on the border with Enkia. Due to the Enkian capitals close proximity to the border the invasion plan would be to advance on the capital as fast as possible to cut off C2 and mop up the remaining Enkians.

First, however, an extensive air campaign would be utilized against Enkia. In the air, UAVs would take care of the relatively small Enkian air force. If any took off they would be well within the range of the P-500 systems operated by the forces in Nestorstaat. The limited scale of the IADS would allow for the quick establishment of air superiority over the skies of Enkia. A precision targeted air campaign would begin with JDAMs being dropped across Enkia on military targets to limit the damage on civilian populations as well as civilian infrastructure. Due to the significant Hochdeutsche population in occupied territories the liberation would have to be extremely surgical in its use of force to avoid bad press for the war effort. IFVs and MBTs would cross the border after 78 hours of continuous bombing, quickly driving towards the Enkian capital to seize control of the leadership. 

Reaching the capital, located within twenty kilometers of the border within four hours the HDF would find the area largely deserted. Outside of government buildings the complete lull would be occasionally broken by a distant explosion. Government documents were scattered and blown across the ground. The hastily retreating Enkian government had attempted to destroy its documentation to prevent the HDF from accessing their contents. The HDF would keep up its pursuit, quickly steamrolling the limited Enkian resistance across the country. Eventually, Enkian leadership would be captured by a special operations operation in the south which discovered multiple high officials hiding in a village hotel. 

Counterinsurgency 

Now that the war had been won there would be insurgents to deal with. Across the country there would be a number of terrorists working against the Republik. Any person holding Enkian citizenship that had illegally settled in southern Nestorstaat would be immediately deported back to the newly established Central Nestor Region (CNR), a military-administered territory in native Enkian lands. Here former members of the Enkian military and government would be placed under heavy surveillance with the newly established Regional Military Police regularly raiding homes, businesses and other establishments to search for weapons and contraband. Terrorist leaders would also be hit with precision strikes via UAV. 

However, the stick would also be paired with the carrot. Scholarships would be provided with compliant Enkians, infrastructure projects would be undertaken and job creation programs would be established. 

Political Reintegration

The Nestor island would be divided into the regions of the Central Nestorstaat Region and Nestorstaat. Nestorstaat would operate as a semi-autonomous free republic, subject to Hochdeutsche law but able to carry out many local powers such as elections and regulation. The Central Nestorstaat Region or CNR would be a military-administered region in the center of Nestorstaat where military law is imposed to curb insurgent activity. 

[/spoiler]
